display.question: What hooks are working this week for language learning apps?

answer.text: Language-learning-app hooks working this week on TikTok fall into a handful of repeatable formats: showing an AI tutor "roasting" or scolding the learner, asking native speakers a direct question as comment bait, overwhelming the viewer with how hard the language is, mascot/character skits from brand accounts, meme-payoff translations, and quiz/test-your-level hooks that demand a score in the comments.
answer.label: other

answer.text: I assumed no follower, view, region or recency limit beyond the question's "this week," so all examples were posted within the past few days.
answer.label: assumption
